analysis.subject_pronoun_errors: Improve evidence and entity continuity in context selection/character memory, then add an explicit resolver contract before prompt assembly. Prompt wording alone is insufficient.
analysis.candidate_effectiveness: Stage 12.1 can only adjust prompt policy. Existing evidence does not prove improvement and cannot replace entity-resolution or corpus-backed evaluation.
analysis.timeout_vs_prompt_quality: Keep separate. Timeout is transport/runtime reliability evidence; prompt quality is semantic output evidence. A timeout cannot score or reject prompt quality.
